label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Fleetwood Silences McIlroy Critics
items.text: Tommy Fleetwood's strong week makes the criticism Rory McIlroy faced while leading The Masters seem unfounded.

items.headline: Bryson Investigates Swing Issues
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau trails by one at LIV Golf Korea after rounds of 65 and 68; he plans to investigate his poor swing consistency despite solid putting.

items.headline: PGA Tour Schedule Overhaul Backlash
items.text: Players express strong unhappiness with Brian Rolapp's 2028 schedule plan that splits events into two tracks, potentially barring stars like Scottie Scheffler and Jordan Spieth from key tournaments.
